name: Burien Green Teens
what_you_do: Two weeks of restoring Salmon Creek Ravine while exploring green careers and earning a stipend. No experience needed. Gloves, tools and lunch are provided.
who_can_apply: Highline Public Schools high school students at least 16 by August 17, 2026 who live, work or learn in Burien. Priority goes to those who live in Burien.
pay_detail: Stipend. The amount is not stated on this page. You also get a gear kit (pants, boots, shirt, hat, gloves, tools).
duration: 2 weeks, Mon to Fri, 9 AM to 2 PM (2026: Aug 17 to 28)
deadline_text: 2026 applications ran May 25 to June 25, 2026. Next year not posted.
how_to_apply: Apply online. About 40 applicants get a 20 to 30 minute online interview. Info sessions were held in May and June 2026.
notes: You must be comfortable outdoors for up to 5 hours and walk 1 to 3 miles on uneven ground. Questions: education@mtsgreenway.org. The page states a $1,200 stipend for full attendance.
